cook.title: TEST Maple Dijon Salmon

slides.title: Gather Ingredients
slides.text: Get everything out before you start

slides.title: Mix Maple Syrup
slides.text: Mix the maple syrup, Dijon, and garlic in a bowl.

slides.title: Put Salmon
slides.text: Put the salmon and asparagus on a sheet pan and brush with the sauce, then season with salt and pepper.

slides.title: Bake
slides.text: Preheat oven to 400°F. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until the salmon flakes.

steps: Mix the maple syrup, Dijon, and garlic in a bowl.

cook.description: Sheet pan salmon and asparagus brushed with a sweet maple Dijon garlic sauce
